name: Roomhue
summary: A smart-home app in frosted glass where every room brings its own colours and backdrop
about: A complete smart-home control app for one family house. Frosted glass panels float over a softly blurred drawing of the room you are in, and the whole app takes on that room's colours: peach for the living room, mint for the kitchen, lavender for the bedroom. Lights have dimmers and a warm-to-cool slider that tints the drawn lamps, with scenes, schedules and energy in rupees. Good for a smart-home, home-automation or interior product, light first with a plum evening theme.
how: On Home, swipe through the room cards and tap one: the backdrop and the app colours change to that room
In a room, drag the big brightness bar and the cool-to-warm slider; the lamp in the drawing glows and changes colour
Turn the air conditioning dial, play, skip and set the volume on a speaker, or switch everything off
Tap a scene: a light burst plays and devices change one after another; save your own scene from what is on now
In Devices, filter by type, toggle, rename, move or remove devices, or add one with the pairing scan
Schedule rules on today's timeline, run or pause them, and pick a new colour for any room in Settings
